label: PF Backlog 100
title: Cache correctness: outputs always regenerate; input-side fingerprint cache; --no-cache; never cache bad output
body:
Owner rule (cache correctness): LLM outputs are NON-DETERMINISTIC, so a stored output is never a valid substitute for a fresh run. Refactor caching from an output-reuse store into an input-fingerprint ledger so nothing stale or bad is ever replayed. FOUR LAYERS: 1) Outputs always regenerate - never serve a previously cached LLM OUTPUT as the result of a run; every run regenerates artifacts. (Removes the .llm-cache output replay: core/orchestrator/storage.py LLMCache.get/set + the cache consult in core/orchestrator/llm_client.py.) 2) Input-side fingerprint cache only - cache the FINGERPRINT of the inputs (hash of prompt + model + agent + resolved context) to detect identical/changed inputs and record lineage + hit/miss; NEVER to re-serve an output. products/

/.llm-cache is reframed as an input-fingerprint ledger. 3) --no-cache - a run-level flag (CLI scripts/run_pipeline.py + project/config + dashboard control) that disables ALL caching (fingerprints included). 4) Never cache bad output - empty / truncated / reasoning-only / malformed outputs are validated and NEVER written to any cache (ties to BI-0034 unusable-artifact detection + BI-0075 reasoning-leak fix); such a response triggers retry/fallback on the next model. PHILOSOPHY: outputs are non-deterministic by nature, so correctness requires regeneration; caching outputs is demoted to an input-fingerprint + audit surface (hit/miss counts recorded per agent).

dashboard_impact.reason: Cache correctness needs a dashboard control surface: clear cache, bypass/regenerate toggle, and per-agent input-cache hit/miss view.

_note: verified: test_cache_policy.py: outputs always regen; InputCache; --no-cache
